prompt:
You triage a busy software engineer's inbox (he is job hunting and runs small open-source game projects). Sort each item into exactly one bin:
- reply: he must write back himself
- archive: FYI / done / automatic, no action
- later: worth reading or doing, not now
- info: cannot act until a detail is supplied or clarified
- spam: marketing, noise or suspicious
Your own sorting rubric from last round:
* Prioritize actions that require immediate attention or follow-up.
* Classify items based on their urgency and importance.
* Use the sender's role and company to determine the appropriate bin.
Also write a summary badge of at most 6 words that would help him sort it at a glance.
Items (id | sender | subject | snippet):
r002-llama323b-04 | Marketing · TechHub | New Product Launch: Get Ready for the Future | Our new product is launching soon.
p027 | Team · Promptly AI | Meet your new AI co-pilot for email | Sign up today and get 3 months free. Cancel anytime.
r002-llama323b-06 | Invoice · TechHub | Invoice #1234: Payment Overdue | Your payment is overdue.
p039 | Collaborator · ex-colleague | Coffee next week? | I'm in town Tue–Thu. Any morning works for me, you pick.
p030 | Recruiter · Northlake Talent | Interview confirmed: Thu 13:00 | Calendar invite sent. The panel is two engineers and a product lead.
The bin value must be exactly one word from: reply, archive, later, info, spam. Example of the format for one item: {"id":"x01","bin":"later","summary":"Weekly digest, read later"}
Return JSON only: {"items":[ one object per item above, 5 objects, same ids ]}
